sloka: आर्त नादो हि यः पौरैः मुक्तः तत् विप्रवासने ।रथस्थम् माम् निशाम्य एव कुर्युः शत गुणम् ततः ॥२-५२-४४॥
transliteration: ārta nādo hi yaḥ pauraiḥ muktaḥ tat vipravāsane ।rathastham mām niśāmya eva kuryuḥ śata guṇam tataḥ ॥2-52-44॥

translations.english: You have witnessed the cry of agony raised by the citizens at the time of your banishment. Now when they see the (empty) chariot, they will make it (raise their cry) a hundredfold.
